BiblicalUsage: Gur-Baal is a place in Arabia, named once in the reign of Uzziah. It stands in 2 Chronicles 26:7, where God helped Uzziah against the Arabians who dwelt in Gur-baal.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gur-Baal matters because God's story happened in real places, and Gur-Baal is one of them.
